name: labs/jdmax__epics-device-lib
title: Lake Shore 336 temperature controller (epics-device-lib ls336 DeviceConnection)
intro: Lake Shore 336 temperature controller (epics-device-lib ls336 DeviceConnection), adapted from jdmax/epics-device-lib. It reads `temperature`, `temperatures`, `heater_output`, `pid` and 1 more; sets `setpoint`, `manual_heater` and `heater_range`; runs `set_temperature`, `heater_off` and `enable_heater`. `set_temperature`: set the target temperature of a thermal zone and optionally wait for the zone to reach the setpoint within a declared tolerance. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
